headline: South Korea Q3 GDP Beats Estimates on Strong Global Semiconductor Demand
summary: South Korea's economy grew more than three times faster than expected in the third quarter, central bank data showed. The growth was driven by booming demand for semiconductors.
why: South Korea is a bellwether for the global electronics and technology hardware supply chain, home to memory chip leaders Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Stronger-than-projected GDP growth indicates robust export revenues and economic resilience.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Booming export demand for memory chips confirms an ongoing cyclical recovery in tech hardware.

why_moved: South Korea's third-quarter GDP expanded more than three times faster than anticipated, propelled by booming semiconductor exports.
